# vMLX 1.6.52

## Changes

- Publish vMLX 1.6.51 updater manifest (`dec283e4`)
- Accept packaged Python launcher in installed proof harness (`d907beeb`)
- Keep gateway model starts non-interactive (`04ec33b6`)
- Realize final media logits before clearing Metal transients (`34ce9f50`)
- Handle wrapped logits in chunked media prefill (`6bf7f7fc`)
- fix(moe): derive fused pair intermediate from projection invariants (`acc8421e`)
- perf(glm5): fuse speculative-verification hyper-connection slabs by default (`48e94abf`)
- fix(loader): match affine metadata dtype to the BF16 compute contract (`c48bd974`)
- fix(bundle): ignore AppleDouble sidecars in safetensors discovery (`df6dac1a`)
- refactor(loader): defer affine metadata dtype to the harmonisation owner (`b6b1f4b0`)
- fix(mllm): run the post-hydration acceleration hook on the VL route (`6a878543`)
- fix(panel): restore greedy startup defaults for enabled native MTP (`ce3a02ed`)
- Support current mlx-vlm video loading (#265) (`c06c9739`)
- Preserve JANG sparse cache during batching (#266) (`ac3ee042`)
- fix(panel): show the pinned greedy defaults in Chat Settings for Auto MTP (`6ebae98e`)
- fix(glm5): stop replaying prior-turn reasoning into the rendered prompt (`7366910d`)
- feat(glm5): opt-in BF16 DSA indexer state and scoring (`7d404bbc`)
- fix(panel): honest Flash-Next residency estimate and non-gating wired dialog (`a516f887`)
- fix(gateway): satisfy codex model-manager; harden GLM template fallback (`093da707`)
- test: update MTP sampling contract test and seed the mHC verify-slab probe (`b31b4529`)
- Prepare vMLX 1.6.52 (`353eb6dc`)
